# ATOMIC SHOP WEEKLY UPDATE: APRIL 11 – APRIL 18

Read on to catch a preview of the latest and greatest items and offers that are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including this week's free items.

#### FREE ITEMS

![Fo1st WaxGrognak](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/4KSUxzGeFccXCGdHGJG7Vx/91b11751a376ad8ec53dfe0234f89ba2/Fo1st/_WaxGrognak.png)

This Grognak Wax Figure is a perfect addition to your collection – free for Fallout 1st members until May 2.

Go team! You too can look like the coolest kid in school with the DB Tech Varsity Uniform, available until April 18.
